title: Exchange Right Schedule — Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
Under the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**, some deal types carry a short exchange right: a delivered vehicle may be returned within a window, up to a mileage limit, against a restocking fee and a per-mile charge for miles beyond a free allowance.

| Deal type | Exchange window (calendar days after delivery) | Greatest miles driven since delivery for an accepted return | Miles driven since delivery not charged | Charge per mile beyond the free miles (USD) | Flat restocking fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | 3 | 150 | 50 | 0.50 | 295.00 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | 5 | 250 | 100 | 0.50 | 295.00 |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | 3 | 150 | 50 | 0.65 | 395.00 |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Points of the schedule
- An exchange window of 0 means the deal type carries no exchange right. Every other column on that row is then zero.
- Hypothetical: a Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase returned with 180 miles driven since delivery is within its 250-mile limit, and 80 of those miles lie beyond the 100 free miles.
